glorice_phsc_ex.product: GloRice (I) gridded paddy rice annual distribution, physical area, Extensive variant
glorice_phsc_ex.citation: Xie, H., Li, J., Li, T., Lu, X., Hu, Q., and Qin, Z. (2025), GloRice, a global rice database (v1.0): I. Gridded paddy rice annual distribution from 1961 to 2021, Scientific Data 12, 182, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04483-1
glorice_phsc_ex.notes: Licence CC BY 4.0 on the figshare data record; the accompanying Scientific Data article is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, which applies to the paper and not to the data. Contains exten_phsc_{year}.nc for 1961-2021, netCDF4, 5 arcmin, 2160x4320, EPSG:4326, variable 'area' in hectares per cell, NaN where no rice. The sha256 was verified on a second fetch on 2026-09-02: the archive was re-downloaded after the first copy had been deleted, and both the byte count and the checksum are recorded from that second retrieval. GloRice allocates national and subnational agricultural statistics to grid cells, so it is a comparison series and not an independent observation of rice extent; see data/processed/README.md.

natural_earth_admin1_yrd.citation: Natural Earth, Admin 1 - States, Provinces (10 m, with lakes), public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com
natural_earth_admin1_yrd.notes: Public domain, no attribution required, no restriction on redistribution or derivative works. Extracted from ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces_lakes in the local cartopy cache at ~/.local/share/cartopy/shapefiles/natural_earth/cultural/, reduced from 121 attribute fields to six (name, name_en, name_zh, adm1_code, iso_3166_2, type_en) and written as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON. gaia_1985_2022.product: GAIA annual global artificial impervious area, 30 m, year-of-first-imperviousness encoding
gaia_1985_2022.version: figshare version 1 of the record (10.6084/m9.figshare.27245775.v1); the archive is named GAIA_1985_2022.zip and its readme is headed Version 2022, but the data stops at 2021, so the archive name overstates the coverage by one year
gaia_1985_2022.citation: Gong, P., Li, X., Wang, J., Bai, Y., Chen, B., Hu, T., Liu, X., Xu, B., Yang, J., Zhang, W., & Zhou, Y. (2020). Annual maps of global artificial impervious area (GAIA) between 1985 and 2018. Remote Sensing of Environment, 236, 111510. doi:10.1016/j.rse.2019.111510
gaia_1985_2022.licence: CC BY 4.0, as stated on the figshare record
gaia_1985_2022.notes: Pixel values encode the year a pixel first became impervious, counting downward from the newest year: year equals 2023 minus value, 0 is non-urban, 2 is 2021 and 38 is 1985 and before. Value 1 is never used in the nine tiles retrieved. Nodata is -128 and is not documented in the product readme, which lists only 0 and 2 through 38. Tiles carry a 30 m merge buffer and therefore overlap, so pixels must be clipped to each tile's nominal five-degree extent before counting. The archive sha256 is null because the 2.3 GB zip was deleted after the nine study-box tiles were extracted and no checksum was computed first; it MUST be recorded on re-fetch. The archive is not internally addressable over its distribution route, so re-obtaining any single tile requires the full 2.3 GB fetch. The nine committed tile checksums below are of the extracted GeoTIFFs, not of members inside the archive, so they verify the local copies but not the archive itself.

s5p_l2_ch4_2018.product: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level 2 methane, RPRO stream, L2__CH4___
s5p_l2_ch4_2018.version: processor 020400, homogeneous across every 2018 granule used; the mirror also carries these orbits at other versions and only the highest per orbit was kept
s5p_l2_ch4_2018.citation: Copernicus Sentinel-5P (processed by ESA), TROPOMI Level 2 Methane total column products. Version 02. European Space Agency. doi:10.5270/S5P-3lcdqiv
s5p_l2_ch4_2018.licence: Copernicus open and free data policy; the MEEO mirror redistributes the ESA products unchanged and states no separate licence
s5p_l2_ch4_2018.notes: NO CONTENT CHECKSUM IS AVAILABLE FOR THIS SOURCE and the archive sha256 is null for that reason rather than because one was not computed. Every S3 ETag the mirror returns is a multipart tag with a minus-N suffix, which is an MD5 of the concatenated part MD5s rather than of the object, and the part size the uploader used is not published, so the tag cannot be reproduced or checked. Verification is structural instead: each granule must open as netCDF4 and hold a PRODUCT group with the methane, qa_value, latitude and longitude variables. That is weaker than the MD5 verification the figshare and Science Data Bank entries carry, and re-fetching cannot be proven to return the same bytes. The two files listed here are the derived composite and its per-cell table, which ARE checksummed, so the outputs verify even though the inputs cannot. The 578 granules themselves are not retained: they total 28.9 GB and were streamed one at a time, gridded and deleted. Pixel values encode qa in stored uint8 units with scale_factor 0.01, and fill values must be read per variable from their own _FillValue attribute.
s5p_l2_ch4_2018.doi_note: Two ESA DOIs exist for this product and both resolve. 10.5270/S5P-3lcdqiv, registered 2021, resolves to the KNMI/SRON product page at tropomi.eu and is the value the granules themselves declare in identifier_product_doi. 10.5270/S5P-3p6lnwd, registered 2019, resolves to the ESA Copernicus catalogue page and was cited here previously. The granule metadata is authoritative for which product was actually read, so the tropomi.eu DOI is the one carried.

natural_earth_china_outline.product: Natural Earth 50 m admin-1 states and provinces with lakes, China only, dissolved to a single outline
natural_earth_china_outline.version: as bundled in the cartopy shapefile cache on this machine
natural_earth_china_outline.notes: Public domain. Extracted from ne_50m_admin_1_states_provinces_lakes in the local cartopy cache by scripts/extract_reference_geometry.py, filtered to the 31 features with admin = 'China' and dissolved into one geometry, written as EPSG:4326 GeoJSON. The 50 m variant is used deliberately rather than the 10 m one used elsewhere, because this layer is drawn only in a locator inset about 3 cm across where 10 m detail is finer than the line width. Those 31 units are the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities Natural Earth files under China; Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau are carried separately in Natural Earth and are not in this geometry. Committed rather than fetched.
